title: Chapter 14 Eternal Galaxy, Eternal Temple
content:
Chapter 14 Eternal Galaxy, Eternal Temple

Walking in the strange galaxy, Lu Daosheng was still thinking about the door of rebirth.

"System, is that behind the door of rebirth really another world?"

【yes】

"What kind of world is that?"

[A higher-level world, where there will be stronger existences]

"System, my wife is there too, right?"

......

This time, the system did not answer.

Lu Daosheng was silent.

Now he has reached the realm of destiny, and there is no place he cannot go in the entire universe.

But now, he couldn't even sense the slightest breath of his wife.

Then there is only one possibility that his wife has left this universe.

[Don't worry, your wife will find it sooner or later, this system will help you]

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

It doesn’t matter whether he is looking for a wife or not, as long as she is still alive.

Now he still wants to do something.

No longer thinking about this question, Lu Daosheng looked up and immediately discovered a new galaxy.

There, it seems to be pretty good.

At the boundary of the eternal star system.

A huge hole slowly appeared, looking like it was torn apart by someone.

The next moment, Lu Daosheng slowly stepped out from it.

"Rareless! Who dares to trespass on my eternal star system!"

Suddenly, an angry shout sounded from the field, and a hostile aura came towards Lu Daosheng.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng frowned slightly.

Why are people outside so rude?

Tear.

The space cracked, and an old man in Taoist robe filled with ancient aura appeared slowly.

"Who gives you the courage to trek into my eternal star system?"

The old man in Taoist robe spoke coldly.

At the same time, a stream of terrifying pressure poured down from the old man's body.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng had no expression on his face.

......

After a while, the old man followed Lu Daosheng with a weak breath and a smirk.

"Senior, I am a gatekeeper in the Eternal Star System, don't mind."

Lu Daosheng nodded, "Which force do you belong to here?"

"Let me go back to you, I am from the Eternal Temple. You should have heard of it."

"I haven't heard of it."

"Forehead,,"

The Temple of Eternal Swords, the strongest force in the Eternal Star System, almost dominates most of the Eternal Star System.

Everyone is a daunting existence.

But the strange senior in front of me didn't even recognize him.

This surprised and confused him.

He just said that he was just a guardian, but he didn't say that he was really weak, it was just that he was weak in front of Lu Daosheng.

Just as he was placed in the entire Eternal Temple, he was one of the best masters.

However, the senior in front of him just waved his hand and suppressed him tightly, enough to imagine how strong Lu Daosheng was.

But such a strong man didn't know that they had never even heard of the Eternal Temple.

In place, Lu Daosheng released his spiritual consciousness. After a moment, Lu Daosheng's spiritual consciousness directly covered the entire Eternal Star System.

I have to say that this place is much more prosperous than the galaxy to which I belonged in that Tianxuan World.

When the strong people here arrive there, they probably have been a dimensional reduction attack.

Lu Daosheng looked up at the distant sky.

There is the location of the headquarters of the Eternal Temple.

At the same time, in the deepest part of the Eternal Temple, a woman in red dress suddenly opened her eyes and looked up.

The next moment, the woman disappeared directly into the hall.

At the boundary of the eternal star system.

Lu Daosheng suddenly said, "You Eternal Temple Lord, are you a woman?"

Hearing this, the old man was stunned and then smiled and said, "Senior, don't you know me Eternal Temple."

Even the palace master is a woman, and he said he had never heard of it.

It seems that he was too worried.

I just said, no one in this world has never heard of the name of my Eternal Temple.

However, Lu Daosheng said, "She seems to be here."

"What?"

As soon as he finished speaking, a woman in a red dress suddenly appeared in the field.

"You are not my eternal star."

The woman in the red dress looked at Lu Daosheng and said coldly.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly and said politely: "This girl is from Tianxuan World, she is just passing by here."

Seeing Lu Daosheng so polite, the woman in the red dress was stunned and didn't know what to say.

She should be vigilant and hostile to Lu Daosheng in front of her.

Because there will be a special rule between powerful galaxies, which makes it impossible to communicate between galaxies, which is the source of the galaxy barrier.

And anyone who can break through the barrier of galaxy is an extremely powerful existence. .

Who knows what the purpose of such a strong man comes to his own galaxy?

Lu Daosheng looked at the woman in red dress in front of him, and was in an unknown state like the unknown man.

Such strong men are all the lords of a galaxy, which shows why the nameless man has been defeated for so many years. Such strong men are not a bad existence.

It’s a pity that this woman is already the boss of a force and cannot be recruited into the deserted city.

"A small gift is treated as a meeting gift."

Lu Daosheng took out a cosmic crystal stone and handed it to the woman in red dress.

Suddenly, the woman in red dress stood there.

He held the universe crystal in his hand and felt it for a moment, then waved his hand and the old man in the robe disappeared directly.

"My name is Ouyang Yanqing, the Lord of the Eternal Temple. They all call me the Lord of the Eternal God."

Ouyang Yanqing put away the cosmic crystal and bowed slightly.

The attitude was a 180-degree turn.

There was no way, this was the most generous person she had ever seen in her life. Who would give a cosmic crystal to someone when they met?

She once had a piece of this thing the size of her little finger, which she used when she broke through the unknown realm.

But now, the strange man in front of her gave her a whole piece, which was as big as a palm.

It was hard for her to refuse.

Seeing the change in the woman's attitude, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly.

As expected, money is still useful.

The long-term experience made him accustomed to treating people kindly, trying to make friends when going out, and not making enemies.

This also allowed him to spend so many years in peace.

Even if he is now invincible in the entire universe, he still has this habit.

"My name is Lu Daosheng, I am the Lord of the Desolate City, and I come from the Tianxuan World."

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing looked thoughtful.

Lu Daosheng, Desolate City, Tianxuan World, she has never heard of any of them.

However, from now on, she will always remember these three names in her heart.

Seeing Ouyang Yanqing's puzzled expression, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "It's normal for the girl not to know. My place is very far away from here. If the girl is interested, you can visit me."

"Okay."

"Ah?"

Lu Daosheng was a little stunned.

"I said yes."

Ouyang Yanqing smiled.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was a little confused.

I was just being polite, why are you serious.

Seeing Lu Daosheng was a little stunned, Ouyang Yanqing smiled and said, "What? You are not framing me, are you?"

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng laughed.

"A gentleman's word is as good as his bond. Since you want to go, why not let me take you there?"

"But..."

"But what?"

Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, "You can only go by yourself."

Hearing this, Ouyang Yanqing hesitated for a moment and nodded in agreement.

There was nothing to do in the Eternal Temple now, so it wouldn't be a problem if he went out by himself.
